messages.尝试关闭光影、图形增强模组和叠加层；双显卡设备可为 Java 指定高性能显卡。: Try disabling shaders, graphics mods and overlays. On dual-GPU systems, assign Java to the high-performance GPU.
messages.尝试相同主版本的较新 Java，并暂时禁用包含原生代码的模组或叠加层。: Try a newer Java release with the same major version and temporarily disable native mods or overlays.
messages.打开崩溃日志，检查末尾异常及其 Caused by 信息。: Open the crash log and check the final exception and its Caused by entries.
messages.日志出现 Java 堆内存耗尽的记录。: The log reports that the Java heap ran out of memory.
messages.日志出现 Mixin 注入或应用失败，可能与模组版本或组合有关。: The log reports Mixin injection or application failures, possibly caused by incompatible mod versions or combinations.
messages.日志包含不支持的 Java 字节码版本。: The log contains an unsupported Java bytecode version.
messages.日志记录了原生异常，需结合 Problematic frame 等信息进一步定位: The log reports a native exception. Check the Problematic frame for more detail.
messages.日志记录了图形上下文、驱动或 OpenGL 初始化失败。: The log reports a graphics context, driver or OpenGL initialization failure.
messages.查看日志中标注的模组名称和所需版本，补齐依赖或安装兼容版本。: Check the mod names and required versions in the log. Add missing dependencies or install compatible versions.
messages.检查 JVM 错误日志中的 Problematic frame；若指向显卡驱动，: Check the Problematic frame in the JVM error log. If it points to a graphics driver, update the driver and disable shaders.
messages.检查参数是否适用于当前 Java 版本，以及最小内存是否超过最大内存。: Check argument compatibility with your Java version and ensure minimum memory does not exceed maximum memory.
messages.检查最近添加的模组及加载器版本，更新或暂时禁用异常模组后重试。: Check recently added mods and the loader version. Update or temporarily disable problematic mods, then try again.
messages.检查最近添加的模组是否要求更高版本的 Java 或不同的游戏版本。: Check whether recently added mods require a newer Java version or a different game version.
messages.检查自定义 JVM 参数中的 MaxMetaspaceSize 等限制，尝试恢复: Check limits such as MaxMetaspaceSize in custom JVM arguments. Try restoring the defaults.
messages.模组依赖缺失或版本冲突: Missing mod dependencies or version conflict
messages.模组加载器检测到了不兼容的模组集合或未满足的依赖。: The mod loader found incompatible mods or unmet dependencies.
messages.用于加载类的元空间耗尽，需检查 JVM 限制或模组加载情况。: Class-loading metaspace is exhausted. Check JVM limits and the loaded mods.
messages.确认模组对应当前游戏版本及 Fabric、Forge 或 NeoForge 加载: Ensure mods match your game and Fabric, Forge or NeoForge loader. Remove duplicate mods.
messages.移除最近添加的自定义 JVM 参数，使用默认配置重试。: Remove recently added custom JVM arguments and try the defaults.
messages.若设置了过大的游戏内存，请适当调低；确认使用 64 位 Java。: Reduce an excessively large game memory allocation and ensure you are using 64-bit Java.
messages.运行库缺失或组件版本不匹配: Missing library or incompatible component versions
messages.退出码只能说明游戏异常结束，现有日志不足以确定原因。: The exit code confirms an abnormal game exit, but the available logs do not identify the cause.
messages.降低资源包分辨率、渲染距离或模组数量后重试。: Try reducing resource pack resolution, render distance or the number of mods.
messages.在档案管理中添加和切换离线玩家，以本地身份启动游戏。: Add and switch offline players in Profiles to start the game with a local identity.
messages.扫描本机 Java 安装，识别版本和架构，供实例选择兼容的运行时。: Find local Java installations and identify their versions and architectures so instances can use a compatible runtime.
messages.使用 Windows 数据保护机制加密和读取本地登录凭据。: Encrypt and read local sign-in credentials using Windows Data Protection.
messages.调用 Windows 文件选择器，打开浏览器和文件夹，并查询磁盘可用空间。: Use Windows file dialogs, open the browser and folders, and check available disk space.
messages.记录游戏运行日志，限制日志大小并隐藏已知的敏感信息。: Write game logs, limit their size and redact known sensitive values.
messages.启动和监控游戏进程，收集运行输出和退出状态。: Start and monitor game processes, collecting their output and exit status.
messages.扫描实例中的模组，支持导入、启停、修改显示名称和删除。: Scan an instance’s mods and let you import, enable, disable, rename or delete them.
messages.导入 Modrinth 和 CurseForge 整合包，也可将实例的版本信息和: Import Modrinth and CurseForge modpacks or export an instance’s version information and selected folders.
messages.搜索 Modrinth 和 CurseForge 模组，下载与实例兼容的版本及所: Search Modrinth and CurseForge for mods and download compatible versions with their required dependencies.
messages.为登录、版本查询和下载提供网络请求，并检查连接地址和重定向。: Handle network requests for sign-in, version lookups and downloads, and check request destinations and redirects.
messages.通过 Microsoft 账号登录 Minecraft，验证游戏资格并恢复已保存: Sign in to Minecraft with a Microsoft account, verify game ownership and restore saved sessions.
messages.管理 Microsoft 和离线玩家档案，选择启动游戏时使用的玩家身份。: Manage Microsoft and offline profiles and choose which player to use when launching the game.
messages.按下载源设置传输游戏文件，报告进度并支持取消下载。: Transfer game files using the configured download source, report progress and support cancellation.
messages.按哈希校验本地游戏文件，复用完整文件并下载缺失或损坏的文件。: Verify local game files by hash, reuse valid copies and download missing or damaged files.
messages.读取 Minecraft 版本目录和版本元数据，解析各系统适用的游戏规则。: Read the Minecraft version catalog and metadata and determine which game rules apply to the current system.
messages.查找兼容的 Fabric Loader 和 Fabric API，并在安装实例时: Find compatible Fabric Loader and Fabric API versions and configure the selected components during installation.
messages.准备游戏客户端、依赖库和资源文件，使选定版本具备运行所需的文件。: Prepare the game client, libraries and assets required to run the selected version.
messages.识别本地游戏版本，管理实例名称、目录和独立设置，并支持迁移旧版启动器数据。: Detect local game versions, manage instance names, folders and settings, and migrate data from older launcher versions.
messages.读取、校验和保存启动器配置，并解析实例实际使用的 Java、内存和 JVM 参数: Read, validate and save launcher settings and resolve the Java runtime, memory limit and JVM arguments for each instance.
messages.创建并安装所选 Minecraft 版本，配置模组加载器，也可修复已有实例。: Create and install instances for selected Minecraft versions, configure mod loaders and repair existing installations.
messages.根据实例配置选择 Java、组装启动参数并启动 Minecraft。: Select Java, assemble the launch arguments and start Minecraft using the instance’s settings.
messages.分析游戏异常退出的日志，给出可能原因和处理建议，并支持导出脱敏报告。: Analyze game crash logs, suggest possible causes and fixes, and export a report with sensitive data redacted.
messages.在 Windows 上处理窗口圆角、背景材质和等比例缩放。: Apply window rounding and background effects and handle proportional resizing on Windows.
messages.提供启动器主窗口的标题栏、侧栏导航和页面切换。: Provide the launcher’s title bar, sidebar navigation and page switching.
messages.提供启动游戏、版本选择、实例设置和下载管理等常用页面。: Provide the pages for launching the game, choosing versions, configuring instances and managing downloads.
messages.查看插件信息和依赖，安装本地插件包，并管理插件的启停和卸载。: Inspect plugins and their dependencies, install local packages, and enable, disable or uninstall plugins.
messages.查找兼容的 Forge 和 NeoForge 版本，并在安装实例时准备所选加载器: Find compatible Forge and NeoForge versions and prepare the selected loader during installation.
messages.加载启动器语言包，并为 Minecraft 设置默认语言，保留玩家手动选择的语言: Load launcher language packs and set Minecraft’s default language while preserving the player’s language choice.
messages.搜索 Modrinth 模组，并为已安装的游戏实例下载兼容版本。: Browse Modrinth mods and download compatible versions for installed instances.
